summary: Practise regulatory signal validation, impact triage, and agile change tracking. Explore the five-day course and its practical work products.
lede: Regulatory horizon scanning is the structured review of developments that may affect an organization, turning signals into actionable change. For compliance analysts, regulatory change leads, and control owners, this course develops a workflow to validate sources, assess applicability and impact with PESTLE and ISO 31000, translate requirements into obligation-to-control records using ISO 37301, and prioritize traceable work in a Kanban backlog.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is for professionals who monitor regulatory developments, assess their effect on obligations or controls, and coordinate documented compliance changes across business functions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with compliance obligations, policies, or control ownership, plus routine spreadsheet use. No coding is required.
